universal_format.description: Every chain entry ships two GLB variants: a plain static mesh and a head/neck-rigged version. To use on a character: attach the static mesh to the neck socket, or re-target the rigged version to that character's neck/head bones. Pendant pendant textures apply as the chain pendant material baseColor.

variants_rule: New chain designs = new entries + new files. Nothing here is overwritten.
